title: Infinite Lantern Corridor
description: A surreal recursive scene shows a metallic mechanical frame containing an endless corridor of repeating ornate glowing lanterns on purple misty ground. The lanterns contain miniature scenes of figures and plants, diminishing into infinity under a glowing aurora sky.
prompt: Surreal recursive scene viewed through a heavy riveted metallic mechanical frame with purple wires, showing an endless diminishing corridor of ornate brass and glass lanterns floating above purple misty ground. Each lantern contains intricate miniature glowing scenes with figures and plants. Soft glowing aurora borealis in purple, pink and orange fills the sky above the infinite hallway, ethereal atmosphere, detailed digital painting.
